# Yousuf Ahmed — Independent Security Researcher

> Portfolio of Yousuf Ahmed, an Independent Security Researcher based in Karachi, Pakistan, specializing in web application security, vulnerability research, offensive security, and competitive Capture The Flag (CTF) competitions.
